content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

Digital product stores that utilize no-KYC payment methods are vital for creators in markets excluded from traditional payment solutions. These stores enable creators to maintain full control over their intellectual property without the burden of exorbitant fees and restrictive account requirements. By using platforms like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to the 10% fee from platforms like Gumroad, creators can retain more of their earnings and ensure their financial sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure of a no-KYC digital product store combines several free and open-source tools. Hosting can be set up using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Payment processing is handled seamlessly through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and provides automatic payment verification. For backend order management, Supabase or Google Sheets can be employed, while automatic delivery of digital products can be facilitated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture ensures that creators own their data and are not dependent on any single platform.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions facing payment restrictions, such as those in Africa, South America, and parts of Asia. It benefits anyone selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software who requires an efficient and reliable way to process payments without the constraints imposed by traditional platforms. Creators can launch their stores quickly and efficiently, taking charge of their sales without high transaction costs.
Keep 99.5% of your revenue with low transaction fees from NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a no-KYC digital product store hinges on several key components. First, the hosting solution, whether GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, provides the front-end framework. Next, backend functionality is managed by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, ensuring low transaction fees. Lastly, Supabase or Google Sheets serves as the database for orders, while file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Together, these elements create a cohesive and efficient commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own no-KYC digital product store, start by selecting your hosting provider, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle logic and order management. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing to accept a range of cryptocurrencies. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store your order data securely and implement Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery. For comprehensive guidance and pre-built templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can build a digital product store using no-KYC payment solutions. By utilizing infrastructure tools like NOWPayments for payments, combined with hosting options like GitHub Pages, you can effectively manage sales and product delivery while retaining full ownership and minimizing fees.
Ownership of your digital products means no platform restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you want to explore more about setting up your store and maximizing revenue without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all necessary blueprints and templates. This resource can guide you in deploying a robust digital commerce stack that supports your needs as a creator.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

The advantages of using a no-KYC payment solution include lower transaction fees, greater control over your sales process, and the ability to operate without the restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors.
